title: Anna Murdoch-Mann, author and ex-wife of Rupert Murdoch, dies aged 81
summary: Philanthropist and mother of Elisabeth, James and Lachlan Murdoch died at home in Palm Beach, Florida The author and philanthropist Anna Murdoch-Mann, the ex-wife of the Australian media tycoon Rupert Murdoch, died at her home in Palm Beach, Florida, on Tuesday. She was 81. Murdoch-Mann’s death was reported Friday by the New York Post , one of her ex-husband’s media properties. Continue reading...

title: Ohio mayor arrested on voyeurism charges after allegedly sniffing girl’s underwear
summary: Claims against Wesley Dingus came from teen who had been staying at his residence and hid camera in bedroom A Republican mayor in Ohio is facing criminal allegations after authorities say he was recorded on a concealed camera smelling an underage girl’s underwear. An incident report from the Richland county sheriff’s Office details the accusations against Wesley Dingus, 48, who serves as mayor of Butler. The claims came from a juvenile who had been staying at his residence. Continue reading...
